problem: Urban community gardens struggle with manual sign‑ups, overlapping plot reservations, and lack of clear communication about plot availability and maintenance schedules.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive web app that lets garden members view, claim, and release garden plots, track planting cycles, and receive reminders, all stored locally for zero‑cost hosting.

competitors.name: Plotly Gardens
competitors.difference: Provides a full SaaS platform with paid tiers; our tool is free, static, and requires no backend.

competitors.name: Garden Manager App
competitors.difference: Mobile‑only with subscription; we offer a web‑only, open‑source solution that works offline.

features: View a calendar of all garden plots with current occupancy
Claim or release a plot with a simple form
Add planting notes and expected harvest dates
Automatic local reminders via browser notifications
Responsive design for phones and tablets

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a paid ‘Premium Pack’ with printable PDF reports and custom branding for larger garden groups.
monetization.free_tier: All core features remain free; premium adds PDF export and multi‑garden support.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Create a GitHub repo and enable GitHub Pages
Share the link in local garden Facebook groups and newsletters
Collect feedback via a simple Google Form linked from the site

marketing_content.tagline: Grow together – manage your garden plots with ease.
marketing_content.social_post: 🌱 Introducing GardenPlot Planner – a free, offline‑first web app that helps community gardens track plot reservations, planting notes, and harvest dates. No sign‑up, no fees. Try it today at https://yourusername.github.io/gardenplot-planner

tests: Open the site on a phone, click ‘Claim Plot’, fill details, and see the plot appear on the calendar. Expected: plot shows with entered name and notes.
Refresh the page; the claimed plot persists via localStorage. Expected: data remains after reload.
next_improvements: Add iCal export for syncing with personal calendars
Implement multi‑garden support with a simple selector
Provide optional cloud backup via free Firebase hosting
